deploymentSteps: 2. Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers & Pages > Create > Pages > Connect to Git > select the repo, branch main, build output directory 'frontend'. Deploy.
3. Create the D1 database: npx wrangler d1 create fs-ai-db; paste the returned database_id into config/wrangler.toml.
4. Apply the database in order: database/schema.sql, then database/seed.sql (fresh) — or database/migrations/001_initial.sql then 002_agents_accounts.sql, then database/seed.sql (incremental).
5. Deploy the Worker: npm run deploy (wrangler deploy --config config/wrangler.toml).
6. Set environment variables in the Cloudflare dashboard from .env.example (placeholders only in the repo).
7. Verify: npm test, then curl the Pages URL and the Worker /api/health route.

freeTierLimits.note: Limits are Cloudflare free-tier figures at time of writing; if a limit changes, pause the affected feature — never upgrade to paid without the owner's explicit permission.

honestLimits.liveBackend: Static site has no live backend until Workers + D1 are deployed.

zeroCostPolicy: Strict. Owner investment is always $0. No paid domain, hosting, API, AI model/credits, subscription, template, plugin, software, paid trial, credit-card requirement or automatic upgrade. Verified free services/quotas only; pause a feature when its free quota ends, never auto-switch to paid.
